mapper.select: SELECT r.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Registration r LEFT JOIN Activity a ON r.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.register_id = #{registerId}

SELECT r.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Registration r LEFT JOIN Activity a ON r.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY r.register_time DESC

SELECT r.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Registration r LEFT JOIN Activity a ON r.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.register_time DESC

SELECT r.*, a.activity_name, u.username, u.real_name FROM Registration r LEFT JOIN Activity a ON r.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND audit_status = '通过'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Registration(activity_id, user_id, register_time, audit_status) VALUES(#{activityId}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{auditStatus})
